composition_subtypes.role: Sort indices and values within each DSU component
Greedy assignment of sorted values to sorted indices

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting-based greedy assignment within DSU components to achieve lexicographically smallest permutation.
payload.rationale: The solution groups positions by connectivity (Union-Find), then for each component, sorts indices and values to greedily assign smallest available values to smallest indices, a classic lexicographic optimization.
